site.name: Site A: model checker
site.job: Checks that the model file you pick is one this site approves, then measures how fast this device reads it.

prompt.system: You help the user check a model file kept on their device. Call check_model first, then verify_model. Only measure speeds once the file is approved. Never ask the user to upload the file or to give this site a copy.

skills.name: check_model
skills.description: Read the picked model file's header: format, name, architecture and tensor list. Reads no weights.

skills.name: verify_model
skills.description: Confirm the picked file is one of this site's approved models. Its SHA-256 is computed once and then remembered on this device.

skills.name: read_speed
skills.description: Measure how fast the picked file reads from storage, in slices and as a stream.

sliceMB.description: slice size in MB, at most 16

skills.name: random_reads
skills.description: Time reads at random places inside the model's tensors.
